MaievUmbralBindBondsOfJustice.name: Bonds of Justice
MaievUmbralBindBondsOfJustice.description: Quest: Each tether applied to a secondary target of Umbral Bind permanently increases Umbral Bind's pull damage by 15. Reward: After applying 5 tethers to secondary targets, increase Umbral Bind's pull damage by 75. Reward: After applying 10 tethers to secondary targets, increase

MaievUmbralBindPursuitOfVengeance.name: Pursuit of Vengeance
MaievUmbralBindPursuitOfVengeance.description: Each Hero tethered by Umbral Bind reduces the cooldown of Spirit of Vengeance by 2.5 seconds and each Hero hit by Spirit of Vengeance reduces the cooldown of Umbral Bind by 1 second.

MaievFanOfKnivesNaishasMemento.name: Naisha's Memento
MaievFanOfKnivesNaishasMemento.description: Activate to make primary Basic Attacks bounce between nearby enemies up to 2 times. Lasts 8 seconds. Recharge Naisha's Memento by hitting at least 2 Heroes with a single Fan of Knives.

MaievFanOfKnivesPinDown.name: Pin Down
MaievFanOfKnivesPinDown.description: Quest: Hit 3 enemy Heroes with a single Fan of Knives. Reward: Increase Fan of Knives damage by 35%. MaievFanOfKnivesBladeDance.name: Blade Dance
MaievFanOfKnivesBladeDance.description: Using Fan of Knives deals 50 Physical Damage to enemies around Maiev.

MaievSpiritOfVengeanceSuddenVengeance.name: Sudden Vengeance
MaievSpiritOfVengeanceSuddenVengeance.description: After blinking with Spirit of Vengeance, the shadow explodes, damaging all nearby enemy Heroes for 6% of their maximum Health.

MaievFanOfKnivesElunesWrath.name: Elune's Wrath
MaievFanOfKnivesElunesWrath.description: Hitting at least 2 Heroes with a single Fan of Knives causes the next Fan of Knives to drop a star on targets that deals 77 damage when it impacts.

MaievUmbralBindBondsOfCorruption.name: Bonds of Corruption
MaievUmbralBindBondsOfCorruption.description: Enemy Heroes pulled by Umbral Bind have their Armor reduced by 15 and are Slowed by 25% for 3 seconds

MaievSpiritOfVengeanceRuthlessSpirit.name: Ruthless Spirit
MaievSpiritOfVengeanceRuthlessSpirit.description: Each enemy Hero hit by Spirit of Vengeance increases all damage Maiev deals by 15% for 4 seconds, stacking up to 30%.

MaievContainmentDisc.name: Containment Disc
MaievContainmentDisc.description: Throw a glaive in the target direction. If an enemy Hero is hit, Containment Disc can be reactivated to remove their vision and Time Stop them for 4 seconds. Leaving Containment Silences the enemy Hero for 1.5 seconds. Containment Disc automatically activates 6 seconds after hitt

MaievWardensCage.name: Warden's Cage
MaievWardensCage.description: Summon 8 Warden Avatars as a cage around Maiev. After 1.5 seconds, enemy Heroes that come in contact with an Avatar consume it and are knocked to the center of the cage. Warden Avatars last 5 seconds.

MaievFanOfKnivesBladedArmor.name: Bladed Armor
MaievFanOfKnivesBladedArmor.description: Each enemy Hero hit by Fan of Knives grants 5 Armor for 5 seconds, up to 20 Armor.

MaievUmbralBindChainGang.name: Chain Gang
MaievUmbralBindChainGang.description: Tethering at least 2 enemy Heroes with Umbral Bind grants 35 Armor for 4 seconds.

MaievSpiritOfVengeanceShadowArmor.name: Shadow Armor
MaievSpiritOfVengeanceShadowArmor.description: Blink grants 20 Armor for 3.5 seconds. Maiev's Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes refresh this duration.

MaievSpiritOfVengeanceVengefulKnives.name: Vengeful Knives
MaievSpiritOfVengeanceVengefulKnives.description: Dealing damage to enemy Heroes causes the next cast of Fan of Knives that hits enemy Heroes to deal 1% maximum Health as bonus damage, up to 5%.

MaievUmbralBindCruelChain.name: Cruel Chain
MaievUmbralBindCruelChain.description: Umbral Bind grants 25% Movement Speed for 2.5 seconds. In addition, each time Maiev deals damage to tethered targets, Umbral Bind's pull damage to all targets is increased by 30%, up to 150%.

MaievArmoredAssault.name: Armored Assault
MaievArmoredAssault.description: While Maiev has positive Armor of any kind, all Physical Damage dealt is increased by 25%.

MaievSpiritOfVengeanceShadowOrbVengeance.name: Shadow Orb: Vengeance
MaievSpiritOfVengeanceShadowOrbVengeance.description: Activate to reset the cooldown of Spirit of Vengeance. Recharge Shadow Orb by damaging enemy Heroes with Spirit of Vengeance 5 times.

MaievShadowOrbHuntress.name: Shadow Orb: Huntress
MaievShadowOrbHuntress.description: Activate to increase Movement Speed and Attack Speed by 40% for 5 seconds. Recharge Shadow Orb by dealing Physical Damage to enemy Heroes 10 times.

MaievShadowOrbShadowStrike.name: Shadow Orb: Shadow Strike
MaievShadowOrbShadowStrike.description: Activate to deal 75 damage to an enemy Hero, Slowing them by 30% and reducing their Armor by 20 for 4 seconds. Recharge Shadow Orb by dealing Spell Damage to enemy Heroes 10 times.
